name: Who Killed The Past?
source:
You play as Alaia Rose, a girl who is struggling with her queer identity. She finds old relicks from a dead family member and wants to explore their life and the mystery of who they are and why she's never heard of them. She will find out the truth no matter what it takes.

[Edited from [url=https://who-killed-the-past.itch.io/who-killed-the-past]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你扮演Alaia Rose，一个正在与自己的酷儿身份作斗争的女孩。她发现了一位已故家庭成员的旧遗物，并想探索他们的生活以及他们是谁以及为什么她从未听说过他们的秘密。无论付出什么代价，她都会查明真相。

[编辑自[url=https://who-killed-the-past.itch.io/who-killed-the-past]Itch.io[/url]]
